infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Reelst uses the camera to record reels of your listings.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Reelst uses the microphone to record audio for reels.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Reelst needs access to your photo library so you can upload listing photos and reels.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Reelst saves rendered reels to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Reelst uses your location to drop pins for your listings on the map.
